repository_evidence.bounded_search_scope: Existing Campaign145-192 source-frontier and source-scouting JSON records only
repository_evidence.cross_asset_boundary: Campaign157 freezes ETF primary-market creation and redemption as a cross-asset source idea. ETF basket activity is not an issuer-level asset manager's complete fiduciary AUM, client flow, mandate, liquidity-control or product lifecycle and may not be substituted.
repository_evidence.operating_scale_boundary: Campaign168 freezes generic customer, subscriber, installed-base and utilization KPIs. A reported AUM total is a monetary fiduciary stock requiring valuation and client-flow reconciliation, not a generic count or utilization KPI.
repository_evidence.commercial_pricing_boundary: Campaign169 freezes price, tariff, fee and selling-term changes. Management-fee or performance-fee rates are therefore pricing states; Campaign193 is limited to client-asset stocks, flows, product or mandate identity and redemption-control lifecycle.
repository_evidence.customer_quality_boundary: Campaign170 freezes retention, churn, renewal and customer-experience KPIs. Client counts or retention rates do not reconstruct monetary subscriptions, redemptions, transfers, valuation effects, mandates, gates or side pockets.
repository_evidence.regulated_capital_boundary: Campaign181 freezes bank, insurer, securities and futures firm capital, solvency and regulatory liquidity. Regulatory own-funds and liquidity ratios are not segregated or fiduciary client assets and do not reconstruct AUM stock-flow histories.
repository_evidence.bank_deposit_boundary: Campaign192 observes bank funding liabilities and depositor flows. A client investment subscription or redemption changes fiduciary assets and is not a bank deposit inflow or withdrawal unless an admitted source explicitly preserves both legal states without relabeling.
repository_evidence.sector_scope_boundary: Point-in-time licensed asset manager, fund manager, securities firm, trust, insurer asset manager, bank wealth manager or other fiduciary-manager scope must be frozen. Nonmanagers are structurally not applicable and may not be filled with zero or cross-sector ranked.
repository_evidence.point_in_time_boundary: Latest AUM, current product rosters or surviving mandates cannot be projected backward without opening stock, gross subscription, redemption, transfer, distribution, valuation, FX, launch, closure, merger, liquidation, correction and first-public histories.
